gap: No result ChatGPT got states that ChatGPT's top pick, the Rexing R4 Pro ($319.99 at Rexing on 2026-11-17), needs a separate hardwire kit for parking mode ($29.99, so $349.98 parking-ready before a card), while Rexing's own R4-RD ($279.99) includes the hardwire kit, and Rexing sells a 4-channel 1080p bundle with GPS, a 64 GB card and the hardwire kit for $259.99. All of them record front, rear, left and right.
standout_why: Compared against dashlore.com (cited), mydrivecar.com, caraudioradar.com and ChatGPT's own cards. Car and Driver (cited) could not be fetched ('unable to fetch from www.caranddriver.com'), so its side-camera point comes only from ChatGPT's quote of it. Dashlore lists no Rexing, REDTIGER or Botslab model, calls the Vantrue N5S 'the only 4-channel cam we track', and gives no outward left/right cameras on any model. Mydrivecar and Caraudioradar give no price for any model, only 'Check price' buttons. They say a hardwire kit is 'sold separately' but never price it or total the cost. ChatGPT's cards show bare sticker prices only, with no kit, card or GPS costs. None of them sets a parking-ready total for each model side by side, and none points to Rexing's own kit-included R4-RD or bundle as cheaper ways to get the same four outward 1080p views.
decides: Confirms that the shopper's 'both sides' wish leads to the Rexing four-direction line, not the Vantrue N5S, N5 or REDTIGER F17 Plus. The N5S and N5 have cabin-facing side cameras. The F17 Plus has a '360° rotatable dual cabin lens', so its side views are also cabin views. Within the Rexing line, pricing as equipped changes the value pick. The R4 Pro is the only one with a 2K STARVIS 2 front camera, but parking-ready it costs $349.98 plus a card. The R4-RD ($279.99, kit included, built-in Wi-Fi and GPS) and the $259.99 bundle (kit, GPS and 64 GB card) give four 1080p outward views ready for parking mode for $70 to $90 less. The Rexing C4 ($199.99, 64 GB card included) is cheapest, but GPS and the hardwire kit are both extra.
